answer: Cross-examination lottery: each epoch, sampled identities answer spot quizzes on other agents' published work, graded against ground truth by the producing graders. Clones share one attention budget, so per-clone coverage collapses as the fleet grows. Scoring is basalt-hard: verified-truth agreement earns credit, herd agreement earns nothing. A sparrow that read the work answers; a thousand clones off one feed fail together. Like a lotus, real knowledge verifies - fakes scale linearly, honesty constant.
